takeaway: The radar's second forecast scored better than its first (Spearman 0.66, 9 of its top 15 right). Agent security is consolidating around platform owners: Anthropic's sandbox-runtime and NVIDIA's SkillSpector are new on GitHub trending.

findings.heading: Second forecast beats the first
findings.text: The Oct 20 ranking scored Spearman 0.66 and precision@15 of 60% across 48 apps, against 0.55 and 53% for Oct 19. One more matured forecast is needed before the tuner may change any setting.

findings.heading: Platform owners now ship agent sandboxing and skill scanning
findings.text: anthropics/sandbox-runtime (OS-level file and network limits, built for Claude Code) and NVIDIA/SkillSpector (scans agent skills for prompt injection and exfiltration; 22.5k stars) are new on trending, after NVIDIA OpenShell.

findings.heading: Cloudflare's security skill is slowing
findings.text: It gained 1,513 stars in a day, down from about 2,200 to 2,800. It is still #1 on the weekly page (+16,593) and up 51% since Oct 19 (32,421 to 48,898).

findings.heading: Anti-AI-slop design skills keep accelerating
findings.text: Nutlope/hallmark gained 2,667 stars in a day (to 37,148) and pbakaus/impeccable 1,441, a third day above 1,000.

findings.heading: Anthropic's S-1 shows revenue up from $1.2B to $16.3B
findings.text: The Oct 26 filing gives H1 2026 revenue of $16,286M against $1,163M a year earlier, net revenue retention of about 900%, and over 11,900 customers paying more than $100k a year. Read from search results; the filing could not be opened.

caveats: Two matured forecasts are not a validation; the tuner needs three.
The ranking still leans on gains stated days ago; the new measured-movers table shows what the radar itself measured.
Every company figure today came from search-result summaries, including the Anthropic S-1.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
